import numpy as np

p_disease = 0.01

p_pos_given_disease = 0.95

p_neg_given_no_disease = 0.90

p_pos_given_no_disease = 1 - p_neg_given_no_disease

p_positive = p_pos_given_disease * p_disease + p_pos_given_no_disease * (1 - p_disease)

p_disease_given_positive = p_pos_given_disease * p_disease / p_positive

p_two_pos_given_disease = p_pos_given_disease ** 2
p_two_pos_given_no_disease = p_pos_given_no_disease ** 2
p_two_positive = p_two_pos_given_disease * p_disease + p_two_pos_given_no_disease * (1 - p_disease)
p_disease_given_two_positive = p_two_pos_given_disease * p_disease / p_two_positive

p_neg_given_disease = 1 - p_pos_given_disease
p_negative = p_neg_given_disease * p_disease + p_neg_given_no_disease * (1 - p_disease)
p_disease_given_negative = p_neg_given_disease * p_disease / p_negative

print(f"P(Disease) = {p_disease}")
print(f"P(Positive|Disease) = {p_pos_given_disease}")
print(f"P(Positive) = {p_positive:.4f}")
print(f"P(Disease|Positive) = {p_disease_given_positive:.4f}")
print(f"P(Disease|Two Positive) = {p_disease_given_two_positive:.4f}")
print(f"P(Disease|Negative) = {p_disease_given_negative:.6f}")
